description: Data-driven transclusion-lattice projector registrations for T12. Each entry keys a projector to released sarf@2 / nahw@2 skill rule ids and carries a projector-record.v1 registry_entry (validated against qamus/schemas/projector-record.schema.json) plus a declarative projector block. A new @2.1 rule registers a projector by APPENDING an object here whose class_predicate and guards resolve to named callables in tools/lattice_projectors.py -- no code change is required when the predicate/guards are among the shipped declarative set.
gate_authority: The known-debt manifest ceiling and the renderer completeness gate remain the deploy authorities. Projectors emit CANDIDATE projections only; nothing here mutates the live whitelist.

registered.grounding: DR-1 primary-source grounding: in Form V (tafaCCala) and Form VI (tafaaCala) the initial taa' is a derivational augment that is STEM-INTERNAL; it is never an inflectional/clitic prefix and must never be carved off as a separate segment. This is a RULE-LEVEL (meta-transclusive) negative projector: it does not project rows, it forbids any occurrence-level projection that would split a derivational taa'.
registered.target_population_note: Applies across the whole candidate stream as a blocking guard; expected certified-base violations = 0 (clean-base proof).

registry_entry.compatibility_class: any candidate projection whose Form V/VI source or projected segmentation splits a derivational stem-internal taa' into a standalone clitic/prefix segment

registered.target_population_note: Rootless whitelist rows carrying a lexical-head (STEM/TOK/*_stem/proper-noun) segment whose morphline asserts no public root. A CERTIFIED root is inherited by transclusion from an ATTESTED source in priority order: (tier-0) the qamus entry headword / usage.forms the lexeme matches; (tier-A) the same match confirmed by the row's own carrier entry_id (self-join); (tier-B) a certified same-surface sibling; (tier-C) a certified same-stem sibling. Pattern alone NEVER certifies (DR-2, sarf-pattern-never-certifies-root): inheritance is only ever from an attested source and stays candidate until the 2-vote / review gate.

registry_entry.compatibility_class: a rootless lexical-head whitelist row whose surface or stem-segment match-key (NFC, harakat/tanwin/annotation-stripped, alif-wasla + dagger-alef normalized to plain alif, hamza/alif-maqsura preserved) is attested as a qamus entry headword/usage.form or a certified same-surface/same-stem sibling, and whose attested sources do not disagree, is not homographic, is not jamid/contested, and is not a divine-name token

registered.target_population_note: Segments whose sarf_note/nahw_note is internal boilerplate ('visible piece accounted', 'no unsupported public source label', 'function/context contribution preserved'). Each is replaced by a deterministic per-(role) pedagogy note. Clitic/affix roles (article, sound-plural, dual, attached pronoun) resolve immediately; a STEM/TOK lexical head requires the P-ROOT-INHERIT chain (note = '<pos> from root X') and is otherwise left for authoring. Never asserts morphology beyond the segment's own attested role + inherited root.

registry_entry.compatibility_class: a certified segment carrying an internal-boilerplate sarf/nahw note whose role has a deterministic pedagogy template (clitic/affix) or whose lexical-head note can be completed by an auto-tier inherited root

registered.target_population_note: Single-token (unsegmented) rootless rows whose surface ends with the feminine sound plural ـات (+ tanwin variants) or the dual/plural ـان/ـين, where the remainder match-key is an attested stem (entry form/headword or certified sibling). Projects a STEM + PL-F/PL-DL segmentation candidate. This closes the C5 tanwin/niswa detector-vocabulary gap (O-2, which had zero candidates). GUARD: a trailing ـات that is a radical ت rather than a suffix (sarf-root-radical-not-clitic) routes to 2-vote.

registry_entry.compatibility_class: a single-token rootless row whose surface ends with an attested feminine-plural ـات or dual/plural ـان/ـين suffix and whose remainder is an attested stem, where the trailing consonant is not a root radical
